definition: The task of generating a novel image based on a natural language text description.
details: Text-to-image generation, powered largely by diffusion models conditioned on text embeddings, has enabled tools that let users create images from purely descriptive prompts without any artistic or design tools.
story: Imagine an art restorer who can spot a single cracked tile in a vast mosaic. What your eyes do without thinking, the machine does one careful layer at a time. The machine learns to see the way we do — starting with shapes and edges, then building up to whole objects and faces. The model looks the way you look at a crowd and finds the one face you know. And that is Text-to-Image Generation — giving a machine the gift of sight.
